queries: SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind;

SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tradekind;

WITH counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, analysis_count, analysis_count::numeric / SUM(analysis_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts;

assumptions.assumption: A NULL tradekind forms its own group, so every analysis with an existing transaction and trader contributes to the total.

alternatives.interpretation: Report only named trader types and calculate shares among analyses whose traders have a non-NULL tradekind.
